ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 21 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly still mixed.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down (investor cycle week 13 · daily cycle day 21).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): uptrend. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 13 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked mid-way — a neutral, balanced structure.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在中段见顶——结构中性、均衡。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 21 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉（投资者周期第 13 周 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
日线动量刚刚向上交叉
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 4 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score +55/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 4 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +55/100）。
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.01 ± 0.21 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLY) reads duration-neutral (+0.05). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.01 ± 0.21——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLY）为久期中性（+0.05）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
